csv_project_name: Conslt for Statewide Advance Signage Posted Bridges Study
csv_scope_of_work: Request for Proposals for a Professional Service Contract from qualified individuals and organizations to furnish those services as described herein for the Commonwealth of Kentucky, Department of Highways. This statewide contract is to assist the Department in the development and delivery of a statewide advance signage for posted bridges study. The Consultant shall provide engineering services to complete tasks including, but not limited to: Develop a scalable GIS-based methodology to map weight-posted bridges on statemaintained roadways, identify appropriate advance warning locations, and determine signage assembly, language, and legends.
